blocks.html: Media is the third largest market research company globally with leading position in its core markets. Ownership of proprietary, GDPR- compliant data set and established household survey panels across products and geographies provides barriers to entry and limits third- party competition. Media also benefits from a steady subscription-based business model (for c.20% of its revenues) and low customer churn rates. The business has performed strongly over the US PE firm’s ownership with improving sales mix and EBITDA margins increasing from ~13% in 2019 to ~22% in 2023.

blocks.html: The Company is the #2 European provider of DTM software and services. DTM enables secure, efficient and legally binding workflows often replacing manual paper-based processes with electronic signatures, identity verifications, digital certificates, and comprehensive audit trails. The Company offers end-to-end DTM services that are considered “compliance-critical” by its customers across various segments and industry verticals. DTM services tend to be embedded within client workflows, which typically makes them difficult to replace. Additionally, they are usually a small component of a client’s overall IT spend, while providing a tangible efficiency and security benefit. The European DTM market is growing strongly (expected 2024-30 CAGR of 12-13%), driven by supportive regulatory trends including the introduction of pan-European frameworks for e-signatures and digital trust, and other related regulations including e-IDAS 2.0, GDPR, anti-financial crime laws, and core cybersecurity standards.
